# Kinly CarePro

> Kinly CarePro is an Australian all-inclusive, audit-proof NDIS practice management platform engineered for disability service providers. It combines deterministic NDIS billing (PAPL 2025–26), GPS-geofenced mobile caregiver app, Guardian™ AI clinical note quality assurance, SCHADS-compliant payroll, and 3-tier staff credential screening—all for a flat $25 AUD per active participant per month with unlimited staff accounts and zero feature paywalls.

## Core Value Proposition & Pricing Model

- **Pricing Model**: $25 AUD / active participant / month (minimum $99/mo commitment including up to 4 active participants).
- **Staff Accounts**: 100% Unlimited support worker and administrator accounts at $0 extra cost (eliminates legacy per-user "casual worker taxes").
- **Feature Access**: 100% All-inclusive. Zero tier paywalls, no add-on charges for Guardian™ AI, payroll, or PRODA billing.
- **Onboarding & Training**: 1 Month Free 1-on-1 Guided Onboarding Support & Live Staff Training with free assisted data migration.
- **Data Residency**: 100% Australian hosted in Sydney AWS (`ap-southeast-2`) in compliance with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and NDIS Practice Standards.

---

## The 8 Core Architectural Pillars

1. **Deterministic NDIS Billing & Claim Engine**: Automatic time-band segmentation (Daytime 06:00–20:00, Evening 20:00–00:00, Active Night 00:00–06:00, Saturday, Sunday, Public Holiday), automated group ratio limits (1:1, 1:2, 1:3, 1:4), TTP loading, and bulk PACE / PRODA-compliant XML/CSV invoice exports.
2. **Guardian™ AI Clinical Note QA**: Real-time 0–100 compliance scoring evaluating shift notes across 5 dimensions: Person-Centered Phrasing (25%), NDIS Goal Linkage (25%), Active Support (20%), Incident & Restrictive Practice Detection (15%), and Clinical/Medication Accuracy (15%). Always human-in-command (staff approve suggestions).
3. **GPS Mobile Caregiver App with Offline Mode**: Geofenced clock-in/out with location verification, live participant care plans, emergency contact access, incident reporting, and full offline caching for rural/remote shifts.
4. **Smart Rostering & The Copy-Week Wizard**: Intelligent shift matching based on staff competencies, participant preferences, fatigue rules, SCHADS award rest break alerts, and 1-click bulk multi-week schedule replication.
5. **Time & Attendance to Payroll Engine**: 3-tier pay rate matrix with standard, evening, weekend, and public holiday multipliers, shift freezing to prevent double-claiming, and 1-click export to Xero, MYOB, and Employment Hero.
6. **3-Tier Staff Compliance & Screening Hub**: Automated verification and expiry alerts for NDIS Worker Screening Checks (NDISWC), Working with Children Checks (WWCC), First Aid/CPR, driver licenses, and visa work limits.
7. **Participant Goal Tracking & Support Coordination Hub**: Longitudinal goal milestone logging, dynamic budget utilization burn-down charts, service agreement tracking, and automated NDIS plan review report generation.
8. **17+ Specialized Reports & Audit Vault**: Shift logs, PRODA claim summaries, incident registers, restrictive practice logs, and payroll variances with an immutable 7-year audit retention trail.
